intro.title: Spelling Bee Practice Zone
intro.subtitle: Everything you need to become a spelling champion!
intro.description: Practice your spelling skills with fun videos, word lists, and quizzes. Whether you're preparing for the school Spelling Bee or just want to improve, you'll find everything here.

items.title: Welcome to the Spelling Bee!
items.excerpt: A friendly introduction to how the Spelling Bee works and what to expect.
items.body: In this video, we explain how the Spelling Bee works — the rules, the rounds, and how to prepare. Perfect for first-timers!

items.title: 5 Tips to Spell Better
items.excerpt: Simple tips that will make you a better speller in no time.
items.body: Learn 5 easy tips to improve your spelling — from breaking words into syllables to using memory tricks.

items.title: Break Words into Syllables
items.excerpt: The secret to spelling long words — one syllable at a time.
items.body: Long words are easier than they look. This video teaches you to break any word into syllables, making it simple to spell.

items.title: Grade 3 Word List
items.excerpt: 100 practice words selected for Grade 3 spellers.
items.body:
This word list contains 100 carefully chosen words for Grade 3 students. Practice one list per week to build your confidence.

Includes: common words, tricky silent letters, and compound words.

items.title: Grade 4 Word List
items.body: Level up with 150 words for Grade 4 spellers. Includes homophones, tricky plurals, and words borrowed from other languages.

items.title: Grade 5 Word List
items.body: Ready for a bigger challenge? This 200-word list includes advanced vocabulary, silent letters, and words from science and history.

items.title: Grade 6 Word List
items.body: The toughest list — 250 words that will test even the best spellers. Prepare for the championship with these advanced words.

items.title: Easy Practice Quiz
items.excerpt: A quick 10-question quiz to warm up.
items.body: Warm up with this easy 10-question quiz. Perfect for Grade 3-4 spellers or anyone just starting.

items.title: Medium Practice Quiz
items.body: Ready for a challenge? This 15-question quiz is designed for Grade 5 spellers.

items.title: Championship Quiz
items.body: Think you're ready for the Spelling Bee championship? Try this 20-question quiz with the hardest words.

items.title: Scripps National Spelling Bee
items.excerpt: The official site of the world-famous Spelling Bee.
items.body: Visit the official Scripps National Spelling Bee website for more resources, word lists, and inspiration.

items.title: Merriam-Webster Word Games
items.excerpt: Fun word games to practice spelling.
items.body: Play fun word games on Merriam-Webster's website. Learn while you play!
